# Concise writing convention for generated content and reports
**Context:** Content auto-generated by `/vibe:*` skills (`.vibe/` files, README/docs sections, ADRs, escalations, backlog items) and the end-of-run chat reports had grown into long, dense sentences.
**Decision:** Every skill that generates `.vibe/`-tracked content or reports back to the user must write short, plain sentences — one fact per line, no filler, no compound sentences stacking multiple facts.
**Reason:** The user (Product Owner, non-developer) reads these outputs directly; brevity and plain words keep them scannable without losing any information.
**Rejected alternatives:** A single shared "style guide" file referenced by all skills — rejected because skill files are self-contained and read independently (no cross-file include mechanism), so the rule is instead repeated at each relevant point, matching this repo's existing convention for small shared phrasing.
